title: Handmade Upholstered Beds Delivered Across Great Britain
body:
Handmade Upholstered Beds Delivered Across Great Britain

Eagle Bed makes upholstered beds to order in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire, and delivers them to your door with our own team. Delivery across Great Britain is free. This page explains how it works.

Where we deliver

  • Great Britain: free delivery to England, Scotland and Wales.
  • Northern Ireland: £90 delivery charge.
  • Anywhere else: if your address is not covered above, contact us before ordering and we will confirm what is possible.

How delivery works

  1. Choose your bed. Pick a design, size, fabric and colour. Free fabric swatches are available if you want to see a colour first.
  2. We make it to order. Each bed is handmade in Dewsbury on a solid wood frame.
  3. We deliver. Our own team delivers to addresses across Great Britain, usually within 3 to 5 working days.

Timings are a guide rather than a guarantee. If you need your bed by a particular date, call or email before you order and we will tell you what we can do.

What we make

  • Upholstered Beds
  • Wingback Beds
  • Ottoman Storage Beds
  • Divan Beds
  • Chesterfield Beds
  • Kids Beds
  • Headboards
  • Mattresses

Payment and peace of mind

Klarna and Clearpay are available at checkout, and our beds carry a 5-year warranty. See our delivery information, finance options and warranty pages for full details.

Contact us

Questions about delivery to your address? Call 07417 439197 or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com. Our workshop is at Pepproyd Street, Eastborough, Dewsbury, West Yorkshire, WF13 1PA.
